# Contributing

Thanks for considering a contribution!

## Reporting bugs
Open an issue and include steps to reproduce the problem, what you expected, and what happened.

## Proposing changes
For significant changes, open an issue first to discuss the idea.

## Submitting a pull request
1. Create a branch for your change.
2. Make your changes and test them.
3. Describe what you changed in the pull request and link any related issue.
